frame_data_guidelines.overview: This section documents the structure and patterns for correct ability frame data in ability_frame_source.json

required_fields.op: Operation code (string) - must match an opcode in this dictionary
required_fields.frame_index: Sequential integer index starting from 0 - determines execution order

optional_fields.value: Integer or object - meaning depends on operation (count, threshold, offset, etc.)
optional_fields.attr: Object containing operation-specific attributes and flags
optional_fields.slot: Object containing targeting and zone information

execution_model.sequential_execution: Frames execute in order of frame_index unless redirected by jumps
execution_model.termination: Every ability MUST end with a RETURN operation (code 1)
execution_model.jump_semantics: JUMP and JUMP_IF_FALSE use value as forward offset (number of frames to skip)
execution_model.conditional_logic: Condition operations set a boolean flag that JUMP_IF_FALSE checks

is_optional.purpose: Marks an operation as player-choice optional (may choose 0)
is_optional.pattern: Optional operation -> JUMP_IF_FALSE(value=1) -> effect if taken -> RETURN
is_optional.example: MOVE_TO_DISCARD with is_optional=1 followed by JUMP_IF_FALSE value=1

once_per_turn.purpose: Restricts ability to once per turn activation
once_per_turn.usage: Set attr.once_per_turn = 1 on any frame (typically first or condition)
once_per_turn.common_triggers: Most often used with ON_PLAY, ACTIVATED, ON_REVEAL triggers

compare_accumulated.purpose: Links operation result to subsequent operation's value
compare_accumulated.usage: Set attr.compare_accumulated = 1 to use previous operation's actual count
compare_accumulated.example: Discard up to 3, then draw equal to actual discarded (see ability #5)

zone_mask.usage: Combined with card_type or character filters

JUMP_IF_FALSE.purpose: Conditional forward jump based on previous condition check
JUMP_IF_FALSE.value_meaning: Number of frames to skip if condition is false

common_offsets.1: Skip next frame (most common - single optional effect)
common_offsets.2: Skip two frames (optional cost with conditional effect)

JUMP_IF_FALSE.anti_pattern: Never use negative offsets or jumps beyond ability bounds

JUMP.usage: Rare in current data - mostly for complex multi-path abilities

optional_cost.use_case: Pay cost to get additional effect

optional_discard_linked.use_case: Discard up to N, draw equal to actual discarded

select_and_act.use_case: Player selects target, then operation acts on it

multi_condition.pattern: CONDITION1 -> JUMP_IF_FALSE -> CONDITION2 -> JUMP_IF_FALSE -> effect -> RETURN
multi_condition.use_case: Multiple conditions must all be true

cannot_do: Create cards from nothing (must move from existing zones)
Access opponent's hand directly (only through specific effects)
Modify game rules beyond ability scope
Execute loops or recursive calls (no backward jumps)
Modify frame data at runtime (static structure)
Use undefined opcodes (must be in this dictionary)

text_mapping.purpose: Map Japanese text phrases to specific frame operations
text_mapping.format: Object with Japanese text as key, frame description as value
text_mapping.importance: Critical for validating that frames match ability text

notes.purpose: Document patterns, special cases, and verification status
notes.verified_flag: Set verified: true only after manual review confirms correctness

issues.when_to_use: When frames use META_RULE placeholders or need manual review
issues.resolution: Document what needs to be fixed

missing_return.issue: Ability doesn't end with RETURN operation
missing_return.consequence: Execution will continue into next ability or crash
missing_return.fix: Always ensure final frame is RETURN

incorrect_jump_offset.issue: JUMP_IF_FALSE offset doesn't match actual frame count
incorrect_jump_offset.consequence: Skips wrong frames or jumps out of bounds
incorrect_jump_offset.fix: Count frames carefully - offset is number of frames to skip, not target index

optional_without_jump.issue: is_optional flag set but no JUMP_IF_FALSE follows
optional_without_jump.consequence: Optional effect becomes mandatory or logic breaks
optional_without_jump.fix: Always follow optional operations with JUMP_IF_FALSE

condition_without_jump.consequence: Condition result ignored, always executes effect
condition_without_jump.fix: Condition operations must be followed by JUMP_IF_FALSE to be useful

wrong_slot_configuration.issue: slot.source_zone or slot.dest_zone doesn't match operation
wrong_slot_configuration.consequence: Operation fails or targets wrong cards
wrong_slot_configuration.fix: Verify zone names match operation's expected zones

missing_required_attributes.issue: Required attr/slot/params fields missing for operation
missing_required_attributes.fix: Check opcode's attr_keys, slot_keys, params_keys in this dictionary

frame_index_consistency.rule: frame_index must be sequential integers starting from 0
frame_index_consistency.enforcement: Gaps or duplicates in frame_index will cause execution errors

value_field_semantics.count: Used for DRAW, MOVE_TO_DISCARD, SELECT_* - number of cards
value_field_semantics.threshold: Used in conditions - comparison value (e.g., count >= 4)
value_field_semantics.offset: Used in JUMP/JUMP_IF_FALSE - frames to skip
value_field_semantics.identifier: Used for heart_type, group_id, character IDs
value_field_semantics.object: Some operations use value as object (e.g., LOOK_AND_CHOOSE with {count, reveal})

slot_object_structure.target_slot: Where operation applies (CONTEXT, HAND, STAGE_0, STAGE_1, etc.)
slot_object_structure.source_zone: Where cards come from (DECK, HAND, DISCARD, STAGE, etc.)
slot_object_structure.dest_zone: Where cards go to (DECK, DISCARD, DECK_BOTTOM, etc.)
slot_object_structure.remainder_zone: Where unselected cards go (for SELECT operations)
slot_object_structure.comparison: Comparison operator for conditions (GE, GT, LE, LT, EQ, NE)

attr_object_common_keys.is_optional: 1 if player can choose not to execute
attr_object_common_keys.once_per_turn: 1 if ability limited to once per turn
attr_object_common_keys.card_type: Filter by card type (MEMBER, LIVE, etc.)
